Hi Devon / Amanda —

Thanks for the quick reply and the proposed time — Thursday 7/22 11:00 PT works for us. I attached a one-pager mapping as requested (also added to the Drive link). Quick answers to your rollback question so you have context ahead of the call:

What a rollback looks like (short):
- Primary behavior: automatic traffic shift to a previous model variant (zero-downtime) when regression alerts cross an active threshold for a sustained window (default: 5m alarm + 2 consecutive evaluation failures).
- Secondary behavior: pause inbound traffic to the model pool and route to a lightweight rules-based fallback for up to 30 minutes while we triage.
- Notifications: immediate Slack + email to the on-call list, and an incident created in our Ops tool.

On Thursday we’ll propose thresholds and show a mock failure in the eval harness so you can see the lifecycle (alert -> canary rollback -> rollback verification).

Action items assigned before call:
- Marissa: create Drive folder and HubSpot milestone (in progress).
- ShopWave: attach a sample of 50 live user prompts (anonymized) to the Drive folder (Devon/Priya).
- Karthik: prepare the harness CI snippet and the canary policy template (attached snippet).

Attachments: prompt-set-mapping-onepager.pdf (added to Drive)

See you Thursday — Monica

monica@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Devon / Team —

I added a short harness integration snippet to the Drive and attached a lightweight CI example (harness-integration-snippet.txt). A couple of technical notes to consider before Thursday:

1) Prompt fingerprinting: we prefer deterministic hashing (sha256) of the normalized prompt to detect drift and tie back to eval examples — this avoids false positives for semantically identical but formatting-changed prompts.

2) Canary policy suggestion: start with a 5% traffic shadow for 24 hours with checks at 1h and 6h windows. Evaluation passes require:
   - Response accuracy F1 >= 0.88 on the prompt set (domain-specific metric)
   - Latency P95 < 850ms
   - No privacy policy violations flagged by the content filter

3) Automatic rollback trigger (proposal): if two of three checks fail for 2 consecutive windows, trigger automated rollback to the previous variant and alert both teams. We’ll demo this during the call using a synthetic regression.

If you can upload the anonymized sample prompts, I’ll pre-run a quick evaluation to show expected signals.

—Karthik
Staff ML Engineer, Inference Runtime
karthik@redwood.ai
